description: This file defines functions and data structures for creating various prompt scenarios used in testing or simulating agent behaviors in a system involving prompt construction, bootstrap warnings, and workspace setup. It includes scenario creation functions for direct, group, tool-rich, bootstrap warning, and maintenance scenarios, along with utilities for building system prompts and reading context files.

methods.name: buildCommonSystemParams
methods.description: Builds common system parameters including runtime info, user timezone, time, and tool summaries based on workspace directory.

methods.name: buildSystemPrompt
methods.description: Constructs a system prompt with optional extra prompts, skills, reaction guidance, and context files.

methods.name: buildAutoReplyBody
methods.description: Generates the body of an auto-reply message, including event line, user context prefix, and main body.

methods.name: readContextFiles
methods.description: Reads multiple context files asynchronously from the workspace directory.

methods.name: buildAutoReplySystemPrompt
methods.description: Creates an auto-reply system prompt with optional group chat context and intro.

methods.name: buildToolRichSystemPrompt
methods.description: Builds a system prompt with tool integrations and context files for a tool-rich scenario.

methods.name: createDirectScenario
methods.description: Creates a prompt scenario simulating direct chat interactions with various turn types.

methods.name: createGroupScenario
methods.description: Creates a prompt scenario simulating group chat interactions with various turn types.

methods.name: createToolRichScenario
methods.description: Creates a prompt scenario involving tool integrations and context files.

methods.name: createBootstrapWarningScenario
methods.description: Creates a scenario testing bootstrap context truncation warnings and their handling.

methods.name: createMaintenanceScenario
methods.description: Creates a scenario for memory flush and post-compaction prompts.

methods.name: createWorkspaceWithPromptCompositionFiles
methods.description: Sets up a workspace with initial prompt-related files (AGENTS.md, TOOLS.md, SOUL.md).

methods.name: createPromptCompositionScenarios
methods.description: Creates multiple prompt scenarios and workspace setups for testing.
